posts.title: Dayclub dress code 101: swim-ready without the red flags
posts.excerpt: Expect to get wet. Here’s the practical mid-2026 dress code for pools, beach clubs, and yacht decks — plus what venues usually ban.
posts.body_html:
Default vibe: swimwear-friendly outfits you can dance in. Resort dayclubs want elevated casual; beach clubs lean more sand-ready; yacht decks may ask for softer soles.

Usually fine

  • Swimsuits + cover-ups, stylish sneakers or slides
  • Lightweight dresses / linen that can handle splash

Usually not

  • Glass bottles, outside alcohol, professional cameras (varies)
  • Sports jerseys or overly casual streetwear at premium rooms — check the event page

Age is typically 21+ unless noted. Final rules live on the venue / ticketing terms when you Book Now.

posts.title: Cabana day vs GA: what to ask before you Book Now
posts.excerpt: Daybeds, minimums, and guest counts live on Booketing/SquadUp — here’s how to shop cabanas without inventing prices on this preview.
posts.body_html:
General Admission gets you on the deck. Cabanas / daybeds / VIP lock a footprint, often with guest counts and spend expectations — details that only appear on the live booking handoff.

What this preview will never invent

Dollar minimums, bottle packages, or “from $X” badges. Demo cart tiers are layout-only labels.

What to check on Book Now

  • Guest capacity and arrival window
  • Whether a deposit holds the cabana
  • Refund / weather language on Booketing or SquadUp terms

Start with an upcoming Vegas or Miami row, tap the labeled Book Now, and read the provider page before you commit.

posts.title: Book Now explained (2026): Booketing vs SquadUp handoff
posts.excerpt: Why some buttons say Booketing and others say live checkout — and why this preview never invents ticket prices.
posts.body_html:
Shoppers should never wonder where a click goes. Mid-2026 PoolParty booking is still a handoff model:

Booketing

When an event page embeds or links out to booketing.com, Book Now opens that microsite. Deposits, refunds, and ticket prices live there.

SquadUp / on-site checkout

Other products continue on poolparty.com with SquadUp-powered checkout (overlay or on-page). This preview deep-links to the live URL — it does not embed SquadUp.

What the demo cart is

A quantity-only shell so stakeholders can feel first-party POS chrome. No prices. No charges. No inventory claims.
